text: Medium: POST /api/logout only expires the cookie client-side; the signed cookie stays valid for sessionTtlSec (30 d) and has no CSRF check (SCD-7: end session on logout). Repro: repro-misc.test.ts -> logout 200, then GET /api/me with the pre-logout cookie 200. Fix: server-side session id or per-session epoch, bump on logout.
